english:
Submachine Guns behave like Lightweight Frame SMGs and grant their intrinsic benefits.

Shotguns behave like Precision Frame Shotguns and grant no intrinsic benefits.

Equipping <exotic MIDA Multi-Tool /> grants 4.5% increased Movement Speed. This stacks alongside Lightweight bonuses for Submachine Guns.

source.text:
SMG: Behaves like a Lightweight SMG | Shotgun: Behaves like a Precision Shotgun
Grants 4.5% Increased Movement Speed while MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped.
Stacks alongside Lightweight Bonuses for the SMG.
